name: Can the devil speak true
source:
Levi Findley might describe himself as quite the average gentleman.

Perhaps a bit rough around the edges, but altogether ordinary.

However, others seem to disagree.

As the new transfer student, he anticipates encountering pompous brats and fuddy-duddies.

Not whispered secrets and an elusive student council.

Well--the nepotism is expected, the cult? Not so much.

Join Levi as he delves into the depths of St. Philomena's, uncovering secrets hidden behind strained smiles and heated glances.

Although, please mind the gap, one misstep and you could fall in~

[From [url=https://hatsvin.itch.io/can-the-devil-speak-true]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
利维·芬德利可能会形容自己是一位非常普通的绅士。

也许边缘有点粗糙，但很普通。

然而，其他人似乎不同意。

作为新来的转学生，他预计会遇到自大的小鬼和古板的家伙。

没有耳语的秘密和难以捉摸的学生会。

嗯——裙带关系是意料之中的，邪教？没那么多。

和莱维一起深入圣菲洛梅娜教堂，揭开隐藏在紧张的微笑和激烈的目光背后的秘密。

不过，请注意差距，一不小心就会掉进去~

[来自[url=https://hatsvin.itch.io/can-the-devil-speak-true]itch.io[/url]]
